ns2:course.label: American Indian Law & Politics
ns2:course.description: Examines the role of American Indians and Indian law in the US political system. Beginning with the core concept of sovereignty, the course then looks at Indian political mobilizations, tribal political economy, tribal governance, relations between tribes and states and between tribes and the federal government, and laws governing religious freedom and environmental issues. Same as AIS 214.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
